verdict.rationale: Token2 ships FIDO2 keys and management tools for passkeys, PINs, biometrics and SSH security keys, so this axis applies to the product. However, no evidence documents a physical touch or user-presence requirement used as an approval gate for sensitive automated or agent-initiated actions. The SSH-key and ssh-agent support is an adjacent feature, and nothing in the pack says it enforces a per-action touch for agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can require a physical key touch as the human-approval step for sensitive automated or agent-initiated actions
